component.name: VideoComponent

Label.text: Play/Pause: pause or resume Left/Right or Rewind/Fast Forward: seek 15 seconds Back: return to guide

component.script:
sub init() m.videoA = m.top.findNode("videoPlayerA") m.videoB = m.top.findNode("videoPlayerB") m.video = m.videoA m.currentVideoSlot = "A" m.audio = m.top.findNode("audioPlayer") m.videoMetadataPanel = m.top.findNode("videoMetadataPanel") m.videoThumbnail = m.top.findNode("videoThumbnail") m.videoTitle = m.top.findNode("videoTitle") m.videoDescription = m.top.findNode("videoDescription") m.videoLength = m.top.findNode("videoLength") m.videoProgress = m.top.findNode("videoProgress") m.videoTime = m.top.findNode("videoTime") m.videoMetadataShowAnimation = m.top.findNode("videoMetadataShowAnimation") m.topVignette = m.top.findNode("topVignette") m.bottomVignette = m.top.findNode("bottomVignette") m.audioPanel = m.top.findNode("audioPanel") m.audioBackdrop = m.top.findNode("audioBackdrop") m.audioBackdrop.opacity = manifestOpacity("audio_backdrop_opacity", 0.25) m.audioTitle = m.top.findNode("audioTitle") m.audioThumbnail = m.top.findNode("audioThumbnail") m.audioDescription = m.top.findNode("audioDescription") m.audioLength = m.top.findNode("audioLength") m.audioState = m.top.findNode("audioState") m.audioProgress = m.top.findNode("audioProgress") m.audioTime = m.top.findNode("audioTime") m.audioVolume = m.top.findNode("audioVolume") m.statusPanel = m.top.findNode("statusPanel") m.statusLabel = m.top.findNode("statusLabel") m.loadWatchdog = m.top.findNode("loadWatchdog") m.prefetchWaitWatchdog = m.top.findNode("prefetchWaitWatchdog") m.skipTimer = m.top.findNode("skipTimer") m.metadataHideTimer = m.top.findNode("metadataHideTimer") m.volumeRefreshTimer = m.top.findNode("volumeRefreshTimer") m.teardownTimer = m.top.findNode("teardownTimer") m.currentItemResolver = m.top.findNode("currentItemResolver") m.nextItemResolver = m.top.findNode("nextItemResolver") m.audioStatusTask = m.top.findNode("audioStatusTask") m.exitDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") m.exitDialog.title = "Return to TV Guide?" m.exitDialog.message = "The rest of this channel's playlist will not be played." m.exitDialog.buttons = [ "Continue Watching", "Return to Guide" ] m.exitDialogActive = false m.active = false m.activePlayer = "" m.videoMetadataVisible = false m.seekShortSeconds = manifestInteger("seek_short_seconds", 10) m.seekLongSeconds = manifestInteger("seek_long_seconds", 30) m.seekDoubleTapMs = manifestInteger("seek_double_tap_ms", 400) m.lastSeekDirection = "" m.seekStopwatch = createObject("roTimespan") m.resolvePending = false m.nextResolvePending = false m.prefetchedItem = invalid m.expectedPrefetchIndex = -1 m.expectedServerIndex = -1 m.currentServerIndex = -1 m.currentResolverDuration = 0 m.liveUsesClockNext = true m.prefetchWarningActive = false m.prefetchFailed = false m.dualVideoPrebufferSupported = readDualVideoPrebufferSupport() m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch = false m.currentResolveAdvancesLive = false m.liveFallbackAttempts = 0 m.liveFallbackFailed = false m.itemStarted = false m.metricsLogged = false m.failurePending = false m.pendingEndReason = "" m.audioVolume.text = "Volume: unavailable"
m.top.observeField("playbackRequested", "startPlayback") m.videoA.observeField("state", "onVideoAState") m.videoA.observeField("position", "onVideoPositionChanged") m.videoB.observeField("state", "onVideoBState") m.videoB.observeField("position", "onVideoPositionChanged") m.audio.observeField("state", "onAudioState") m.audio.observeField("position", "onAudioPositionChanged") m.currentItemResolver.observeField("mediaUrl", "onCurrentMediaUrlResolved") m.currentItemResolver.observeField("errorMessage", "onCurrentMediaUrlError") m.nextItemResolver.observeField("mediaUrl", "onNextMediaUrlResolved") m.nextItemResolver.observeField("errorMessage", "onNextMediaUrlError") m.audioStatusTask.observeField("statusText", "onAudioStatusLoaded") m.loadWatchdog.observeField("fire", "onLoadTimeout") m.prefetchWaitWatchdog.observeField("fire", "onPrefetchWaitTimeout") m.skipTimer.observeField("fire", "playNext") m.metadataHideTimer.observeField("fire", "onMetadataHideTimer") m.volumeRefreshTimer.observeField("fire", "refreshAudioStatus") m.teardownTimer.observeField("fire", "finishPlaybackEnd") m.exitDialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onExitDialogButton") m.exitDialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onExitDialogClosed") end sub
sub startPlayback() if m.top.playlist = invalid then return m.teardownTimer.control = "stop" m.pendingEndReason = "" m.dualVideoPrebufferSupported = readDualVideoPrebufferSupport() exitDestination = m.top.exitDestinationLabel if exitDestination = "" then exitDestination = "TV Guide" m.exitDialog.title = "Return to " + exitDestination + "?" m.exitDialog.buttons = [ "Continue Watching", "Return to " + exitDestination ] count = m.top.playlist.getChildCount() if count = 0 endPlayback("error") return end if
m.currentIndex = m.top.startIndex if m.currentIndex < 0 then m.currentIndex = 0 if m.currentIndex >= count then m.currentIndex = count - 1 resetPlaybackSlots() m.currentServerIndex = -1 m.liveUsesClockNext = true m.prefetchedItem = invalid m.prefetchFailed = false m.nextResolvePending = false m.expectedPrefetchIndex = -1 m.expectedServerIndex = -1 m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch = false m.currentResolveAdvancesLive = false m.liveFallbackAttempts = 0 m.liveFallbackFailed = false m.active = true m.currentItemResolver.control = "stop" m.nextItemResolver.control = "stop" playCurrent() end sub
sub resetPlaybackSlots() m.videoA.control = "stop" m.videoB.control = "stop" m.videoA.content = invalid m.videoB.content = invalid m.videoA.visible = true m.videoB.visible = false m.video = m.videoA m.currentVideoSlot = "A" end sub
sub playCurrent() if not m.active then return item = m.top.playlist.getChild(m.currentIndex) if item = invalid endPlayback("finished") return end if
if item.resolveUrl <> "" m.resolvePending = true m.currentResolveAdvancesLive = false showStatus("Selecting program " + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() + " of " + m.top.playlist.getChildCount().toStr() + "...") m.currentItemResolver.control = "stop" m.currentItemResolver.uri = item.resolveUrl m.currentItemResolver.control = "run" return end if resolved = resolvedItem(item.url, item.title, item.streamFormat, item.description, item.HDPosterUrl, item.metadataLength, 0, m.currentIndex, -1, 0) startResolvedMedia(resolved) end sub
sub onCurrentMediaUrlResolved(event as object) mediaUrl = event.getData() if not m.active or not m.resolvePending or mediaUrl = "" then return m.resolvePending = false item = m.top.playlist.getChild(m.currentIndex) title = m.currentItemResolver.mediaTitle if title = "" and item <> invalid then title = item.title if title = "" then title = m.top.channelTitle + " - Program " + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() description = m.currentItemResolver.mediaDescription thumbnail = m.currentItemResolver.mediaThumbnail length = m.currentItemResolver.mediaLength if item <> invalid if description = "" then description = item.description if thumbnail = "" then thumbnail = item.HDPosterUrl if length < 0 then length = item.metadataLength end if resolved = resolvedItem(mediaUrl, title, m.currentItemResolver.streamFormat, description, thumbnail, length, m.currentItemResolver.positionSeconds, m.currentIndex, m.currentItemResolver.playlistIndex, m.currentItemResolver.resolverDuration) if m.currentResolveAdvancesLive and m.expectedServerIndex >= 0 and resolved.serverIndex <> m.expectedServerIndex m.currentResolveAdvancesLive = false m.liveFallbackAttempts++ showPrefetchWarning("The server returned a different live program than expected.", "The player will retry the expected indexed program.") if m.liveFallbackAttempts <= 1 m.liveUsesClockNext = false fallbackToNextItem(m.currentIndex) else m.liveFallbackFailed = true skipFailedItem("The expected live program could not be validated.") end if return end if if m.currentResolveAdvancesLive then m.liveUsesClockNext = false m.currentResolveAdvancesLive = false startResolvedMedia(resolved) end sub
sub onCurrentMediaUrlError(event as object) message = event.getData() if not m.active or not m.resolvePending or message = "" then return m.resolvePending = false skipFailedItem(message) end sub
sub maybePrefetchNext(position as dynamic, duration as dynamic) if not m.active or m.top.singleItem or m.nextResolvePending or m.prefetchedItem <> invalid or m.prefetchFailed then return if duration = invalid or duration <= 0 then duration = m.activeContentLength if duration = invalid or duration <= 0 then return if position = invalid or position < 0 then position = 0
leadSeconds = int(duration * 0.1) if leadSeconds < 30 then leadSeconds = 30 if leadSeconds > 180 then leadSeconds = 180 if position < duration - leadSeconds then return
nextIndex = nextLogicalIndex() if nextIndex < 0 then return item = m.top.playlist.getChild(nextIndex) if item = invalid then return
m.expectedPrefetchIndex = nextIndex m.expectedServerIndex = expectedNextServerIndex() resolverUri = nextResolverUri(item) if resolverUri = "" m.prefetchedItem = resolvedItem(item.url, item.title, item.streamFormat, item.description, item.HDPosterUrl, item.metadataLength, 0, nextIndex, -1, 0) prebufferPrefetchedVideo() return end if
m.nextResolvePending = true m.nextItemResolver.control = "stop" m.nextItemResolver.uri = resolverUri m.nextItemResolver.control = "run" end sub
function nextLogicalIndex() as integer if m.top.playbackMode = "live" then return m.currentIndex nextIndex = m.currentIndex + 1 if nextIndex < m.top.playlist.getChildCount() then return nextIndex if m.top.loopPlaylist then return 0 return -1 end function
function expectedNextServerIndex() as integer if m.top.playbackMode = "onDemand" nextIndex = nextLogicalIndex() if nextIndex < 0 then return -1 item = m.top.playlist.getChild(nextIndex) if item <> invalid and item.resolverIndex <> invalid then return item.resolverIndex return -1 end if if m.top.playbackMode <> "live" or m.currentServerIndex < 0 then return -1 nextIndex = m.currentServerIndex + 1 if m.top.livePlaylistCount > 0 and nextIndex >= m.top.livePlaylistCount then nextIndex = 0 return nextIndex end function
function nextResolverUri(item as object) as string if m.top.playbackMode <> "live" then return item.resolveUrl baseUri = liveBaseUri(item.resolveUrl) if baseUri = "" then return "" if m.liveUsesClockNext then return baseUri + "/live/next" if m.expectedServerIndex < 0 then return baseUri + "/live/next" return baseUri + "/" + m.expectedServerIndex.toStr() end function
function liveBaseUri(uri as string) as string value = uri while value.len() > 0 and value.right(1) = "/" value = value.left(value.len() - 1) end while if LCase(value.right(5)) = "/live" then return value.left(value.len() - 5) liveAt = instr(1, LCase(value), "/live/") if liveAt > 0 then return value.left(liveAt - 1) return value end function
sub onNextMediaUrlResolved(event as object) mediaUrl = event.getData() if not m.active or not m.nextResolvePending or mediaUrl = "" then return m.nextResolvePending = false
actualServerIndex = m.nextItemResolver.playlistIndex if m.expectedServerIndex >= 0 and actualServerIndex <> m.expectedServerIndex invalidatePrefetch("The server returned a different program than expected.") return end if
item = m.top.playlist.getChild(m.expectedPrefetchIndex) if item = invalid invalidatePrefetch("The next playlist item is no longer available.") return end if title = m.nextItemResolver.mediaTitle if title = "" then title = item.title if title = "" then title = m.top.channelTitle + " - Program " + (m.expectedPrefetchIndex + 1).toStr() description = m.nextItemResolver.mediaDescription thumbnail = m.nextItemResolver.mediaThumbnail length = m.nextItemResolver.mediaLength if description = "" then description = item.description if thumbnail = "" then thumbnail = item.HDPosterUrl if length < 0 then length = item.metadataLength m.prefetchedItem = resolvedItem(mediaUrl, title, m.nextItemResolver.streamFormat, description, thumbnail, length, m.nextItemResolver.positionSeconds, m.expectedPrefetchIndex, actualServerIndex, m.nextItemResolver.resolverDuration) prebufferPrefetchedVideo() if m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch = false m.prefetchWaitWatchdog.control = "stop" promotePrefetchedItem() end if end sub
sub onNextMediaUrlError(event as object) message = event.getData() if not m.active or not m.nextResolvePending or message = "" then return m.nextResolvePending = false invalidatePrefetch(message) end sub
sub prebufferPrefetchedVideo() if m.prefetchedItem = invalid or m.prefetchedItem.isAudio then return if not m.dualVideoPrebufferSupported m.prefetchedItem.prebuffered = false return end if standby = standbyVideo() standby.control = "stop" standby.content = m.prefetchedItem.content standby.visible = false m.prefetchedItem.prebuffered = true standby.control = "prebuffer" end sub
sub invalidatePrefetch(message as string) standby = standbyVideo() standby.control = "stop" standby.content = invalid m.prefetchedItem = invalid m.prefetchFailed = true showPrefetchWarning(message, "The player will retry when the current program ends.") if m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch = false m.prefetchWaitWatchdog.control = "stop" fallbackToNextItem(m.expectedPrefetchIndex) end if end sub
sub handlePrebufferFailure(message as string) standby = standbyVideo() standby.control = "stop" standby.content = invalid if m.prefetchedItem <> invalid then m.prefetchedItem.prebuffered = false m.prefetchFailed = true if isDualVideoUnsupportedError(message) m.dualVideoPrebufferSupported = false saveDualVideoPrebufferSupport(false) print "[Playback] Dual-video prebuffering disabled on this device: "; message return end if showPrefetchWarning(message, "The cached program will start without prebuffering.") end sub
function isDualVideoUnsupportedError(message as string) as boolean return instr(1, LCase(message), "only one playing instance supported") > 0 end function
sub showPrefetchWarning(message as string, action as string) if m.prefetchWarningActive then return m.prefetchWarningDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") m.prefetchWarningDialog.title = "Playback May Be Interrupted" m.prefetchWarningDialog.message = message + " " + action m.prefetchWarningDialog.buttons = [ "OK" ] m.prefetchWarningDialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onPrefetchWarningClosed") m.prefetchWarningDialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onPrefetchWarningClosed") m.prefetchWarningActive = true m.top.getScene().dialog = m.prefetchWarningDialog end sub
sub onPrefetchWarningClosed() if m.prefetchWarningDialog <> invalid then m.prefetchWarningDialog.close = true m.prefetchWarningDialog = invalid m.prefetchWarningActive = false if m.active if m.activePlayer = "video" m.video.setFocus(true) else m.top.setFocus(true) end if end if end sub
function resolvedItem(url as string, title as string, streamFormat as string, description as string, thumbnail as string, length as integer, startPosition as integer, logicalIndex as integer, serverIndex as integer, resolverDuration as float) as object content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = url if isAudioUrl(url) content.title = cleanMediaTitle(title) else content.title = title end if content.streamFormat = streamFormat content.description = description content.HDPosterUrl = thumbnail content.live = false if length > 0 then content.length = length content.httpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt" if startPosition > 0 then content.PlayStart = startPosition return { content: content url: url title: content.title description: description thumbnail: thumbnail length: length startPosition: startPosition logicalIndex: logicalIndex serverIndex: serverIndex resolverDuration: resolverDuration isAudio: isAudioUrl(url) prebuffered: false } end function
sub startResolvedMedia(resolved as object) m.itemStarted = false m.metricsLogged = false m.failurePending = false m.prefetchFailed = false m.liveFallbackAttempts = 0 m.liveFallbackFailed = false m.currentServerIndex = resolved.serverIndex m.currentResolverDuration = resolved.resolverDuration m.activeContentTitle = resolved.title m.activeContentDescription = resolved.description m.activeContentThumbnail = resolved.thumbnail m.activeContentLength = resolved.length
showStatus("Loading " + resolved.title + " (" + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() + " of " + m.top.playlist.getChildCount().toStr() + ")") if resolved.isAudio m.activePlayer = "audio" m.video.control = "stop" m.video.content = invalid hideVideoMetadata() showAudioPanel(resolved.title, "Loading") m.audio.autoplayAfterSeek = true m.audio.content = resolved.content m.audio.control = "play" refreshAudioStatus() m.volumeRefreshTimer.control = "start" m.top.setFocus(true) else m.activePlayer = "video" hideAudioPanel() hideVideoMetadata() m.audio.control = "stop" m.volumeRefreshTimer.control = "stop" m.video.visible = true m.video.content = resolved.content m.video.control = "play" m.video.setFocus(true) end if m.loadWatchdog.control = "start" end sub
function extensionFromUrl(url as string) as string cleanUrl = url queryAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "?") if queryAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(fragmentAt - 1) extension = "" for index = len(cleanUrl) to 1 step -1 character = cleanUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) if character = "." extension = LCase(cleanUrl.mid(index)) exit for end if if character = "/" then exit for end for return extension end function
function isAudioUrl(url as string) as boolean extension = extensionFromUrl(url) return extension = "mp3" or extension = "m4a" or extension = "wav" or extension = "aac" end function
function cleanMediaTitle(title as string) as string cleanTitle = title
queryAt = instr(1, cleanTitle, "?") if queryAt > 0 then cleanTitle = cleanTitle.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, cleanTitle, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then cleanTitle = cleanTitle.left(fragmentAt - 1)
for index = len(cleanTitle) to 1 step -1 character = cleanTitle.mid(index - 1, 1) if character = "/" or character = "\" cleanTitle = cleanTitle.mid(index) exit for end if end for if cleanTitle = "" then return title return cleanTitle end function
sub onVideoAState(event as object) onVideoSlotState("A", event.getData()) end sub
sub onVideoBState(event as object) onVideoSlotState("B", event.getData()) end sub
sub onVideoSlotState(slot as string, state as string) if not m.active then return if slot <> m.currentVideoSlot if state = "error" and m.prefetchedItem <> invalid and m.prefetchedItem.prebuffered handlePrebufferFailure(playbackErrorMessage(videoForSlot(slot))) end if return end if if m.activePlayer = "video" then onPlayerState(state, videoForSlot(slot)) end sub
sub onAudioState(event as object) if not m.active or m.activePlayer <> "audio" then return onPlayerState(event.getData(), m.audio) end sub
sub onPlayerState(state as string, player as object) if state = "playing" m.itemStarted = true m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" if not m.metricsLogged m.metricsLogged = true logPlaybackMetrics(player) end if if m.activePlayer = "video" hideStatus() maybePrefetchNext(player.position, player.duration) else hideStatus() showAudioPanel(m.activeContentTitle, "Playing") updateAudioProgress() maybePrefetchNext(player.position, player.duration) end if else if state = "paused" and m.activePlayer = "audio" showAudioPanel(m.activeContentTitle, "Paused") updateAudioProgress() else if state = "finished" if not m.itemStarted then return m.itemStarted = false m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" playNext() else if state = "error" m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" skipFailedItem(playbackErrorMessage(player)) end if end sub
sub onLoadTimeout() if not m.active then return player = activePlayerNode() if player <> invalid and player.state = "playing" then return if player <> invalid then player.control = "stop" skipFailedItem("This playlist item timed out.") end sub
sub skipFailedItem(message as string) if not m.active or m.failurePending then return m.failurePending = true if m.top.singleItem showStatus(message + " Returning to the program guide...") else showStatus(message + " Skipping to the next item...") end if m.skipTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub playNext() if not m.active then return m.skipTimer.control = "stop" m.failurePending = false if m.top.singleItem endPlayback("finished") return end if if m.liveFallbackFailed endPlayback("error") return end if nextIndex = nextLogicalIndex() if nextIndex < 0 endPlayback("finished") return end if if m.prefetchedItem <> invalid and m.prefetchedItem.logicalIndex = nextIndex promotePrefetchedItem() return end if if m.nextResolvePending m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch = true showStatus("Preparing the next program...") m.prefetchWaitWatchdog.control = "start" return end if fallbackToNextItem(nextIndex) end sub
sub fallbackToNextItem(nextIndex as integer) if nextIndex < 0 endPlayback("finished") return end if m.currentIndex = nextIndex if m.top.playbackMode <> "live" playCurrent() return end if
item = m.top.playlist.getChild(nextIndex) if item = invalid endPlayback("finished") return end if m.expectedPrefetchIndex = nextIndex m.expectedServerIndex = expectedNextServerIndex() resolverUri = nextResolverUri(item) if resolverUri = "" skipFailedItem("The next Live TV resolver URL is missing.") return end if m.resolvePending = true m.currentResolveAdvancesLive = true showStatus("Selecting the next live program...") m.currentItemResolver.control = "stop" m.currentItemResolver.uri = resolverUri m.currentItemResolver.control = "run" end sub
sub onPrefetchWaitTimeout() if not m.active or not m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch then return m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch = false m.nextResolvePending = false m.nextItemResolver.control = "stop" invalidatePrefetch("The next program reservation timed out.") fallbackToNextItem(m.expectedPrefetchIndex) end sub
sub promotePrefetchedItem() resolved = m.prefetchedItem m.prefetchedItem = invalid m.currentIndex = resolved.logicalIndex if m.top.playbackMode = "live" then m.liveUsesClockNext = false
if resolved.isAudio startResolvedMedia(resolved) return end if
if not resolved.prebuffered m.video.control = "stop" m.video.content = invalid startResolvedMedia(resolved) return end if
oldVideo = m.video if m.currentVideoSlot = "A" m.currentVideoSlot = "B" m.video = m.videoB else m.currentVideoSlot = "A" m.video = m.videoA end if
m.itemStarted = false m.metricsLogged = false m.failurePending = false m.currentServerIndex = resolved.serverIndex m.currentResolverDuration = resolved.resolverDuration m.activeContentTitle = resolved.title m.activeContentDescription = resolved.description m.activeContentThumbnail = resolved.thumbnail m.activeContentLength = resolved.length hideAudioPanel() hideVideoMetadata() m.audio.control = "stop" m.volumeRefreshTimer.control = "stop"
oldVideo.visible = false oldVideo.control = "stop" oldVideo.content = invalid m.video.visible = true m.video.control = "play" m.activePlayer = "video" m.video.setFocus(true) m.loadWatchdog.control = "start" end sub
function standbyVideo() as object if m.currentVideoSlot = "A" then return m.videoB return m.videoA end function
function videoForSlot(slot as string) as object if slot = "A" then return m.videoA return m.videoB end function
sub logPlaybackMetrics(player as object) info = invalid if player <> invalid then info = player.playStartInfo totalDuration = metricValue(info, "total_dur") manifestDuration = metricValue(info, "manifest_dur") prebufferDuration = metricValue(info, "prebuf_dur") print "[PlaybackMetrics] resolver_dur="; m.currentResolverDuration; " total_dur="; totalDuration; " manifest_dur="; manifestDuration; " prebuf_dur="; prebufferDuration end sub
function metricValue(info as dynamic, key as string) as float if type(info) = "roAssociativeArray" and info.doesExist(key) and info[key] <> invalid then return info[key] return -1 end function
function activePlayerNode() as object if m.activePlayer = "audio" then return m.audio if m.activePlayer = "video" then return m.video return invalid end function
function playbackErrorMessage(player as object) as string if player <> invalid and player.errorMsg <> invalid and player.errorMsg <> "" then return player.errorMsg + "." if player <> invalid and player.errorStr <> invalid and player.errorStr <> "" then return player.errorStr + "." return "This playlist item could not be played." end function
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" and m.active if m.top.singleItem endPlayback("user") return true end if if not m.exitDialogActive m.exitDialogActive = true m.top.getScene().dialog = m.exitDialog end if return true end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "video" and key = "OK" if m.videoMetadataVisible hideVideoMetadata() else showVideoMetadata() end if return true end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "video" and key = "play" if m.video.state = "paused" m.video.control = "resume" else if m.video.state = "playing" m.video.control = "pause" end if if not m.videoMetadataVisible then showVideoMetadata() return true end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "video" and (key = "rewind" or key = "left") seekVideo(-videoSeekAmount("left")) if not m.videoMetadataVisible showVideoMetadata() else m.metadataHideTimer.control = "stop" m.metadataHideTimer.control = "start" end if return true end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "video" and (key = "fastforward" or key = "right") seekVideo(videoSeekAmount("right")) if not m.videoMetadataVisible showVideoMetadata() else m.metadataHideTimer.control = "stop" m.metadataHideTimer.control = "start" end if return true end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "play" if m.audio.state = "paused" m.audio.autoplayAfterSeek = true m.audio.control = "resume" else if m.audio.state = "playing" m.audio.control = "pause" end if return true end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "rewind" return seekAudio(-15) end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "fastforward" return seekAudio(15) end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "left" return seekAudio(-15) end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "right" return seekAudio(15) end if return false end function
function seekAudio(offset as integer) as boolean position = m.audio.position duration = m.audio.duration if position = invalid or duration = invalid or duration <= 0 then return false
targetPosition = position + offset if targetPosition < 0 then targetPosition = 0 if targetPosition > duration then targetPosition = duration m.audio.autoplayAfterSeek = (m.audio.state = "playing") m.audio.seek = targetPosition updateAudioProgressAt(targetPosition, duration) return true end function
function videoSeekAmount(direction as string) as integer elapsed = m.seekStopwatch.totalMilliseconds() if direction = m.lastSeekDirection and elapsed <= m.seekDoubleTapMs amount = m.seekLongSeconds else amount = m.seekShortSeconds end if m.lastSeekDirection = direction m.seekStopwatch.mark() return amount end function
function seekVideo(offset as integer) as boolean position = m.video.position duration = m.video.duration if position = invalid or duration = invalid or duration <= 0 then return false
targetPosition = position + offset if targetPosition < 0 then targetPosition = 0 if targetPosition > duration then targetPosition = duration m.video.seek = targetPosition updateVideoProgressAt(targetPosition, duration) return true end function
sub onAudioPositionChanged() if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" updateAudioProgress() maybePrefetchNext(m.audio.position, m.audio.duration) end if end sub
sub updateAudioProgress() updateAudioProgressAt(m.audio.position, m.audio.duration) end sub
sub updateAudioProgressAt(position as dynamic, duration as dynamic) if position = invalid or position < 0 then position = 0 if duration = invalid or duration <= 0 duration = m.activeContentLength if duration < 0 then duration = 0 end if
progressWidth = 0 if duration > 0 progressWidth = int(1520 * position / duration) if progressWidth < 0 then progressWidth = 0 if progressWidth > 1520 then progressWidth = 1520 end if m.audioProgress.width = progressWidth m.audioTime.text = formatTime(position) + " / " + formatTime(duration) end sub
function formatTime(value as dynamic) as string if value = invalid or value < 0 then value = 0 totalSeconds = int(value) hours = int(totalSeconds / 3600) minutes = int((totalSeconds mod 3600) / 60) seconds = totalSeconds mod 60 secondsText = seconds.toStr() if seconds < 10 then secondsText = "0" + secondsText minutesText = minutes.toStr() if hours > 0 and minutes < 10 then minutesText = "0" + minutesText if hours > 0 then return hours.toStr() + ":" + minutesText + ":" + secondsText return minutesText + ":" + secondsText end function
sub showAudioPanel(title as string, state as string) m.audioTitle.text = title m.audioBackdrop.uri = m.activeContentThumbnail m.audioBackdrop.visible = (m.activeContentThumbnail <> "") m.audioDescription.text = m.activeContentDescription m.audioThumbnail.uri = m.activeContentThumbnail m.audioThumbnail.visible = (m.activeContentThumbnail <> "") m.audioLength.text = metadataLengthText(m.activeContentLength) m.audioState.text = state + " | Track " + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() + " of " + m.top.playlist.getChildCount().toStr() m.audioPanel.visible = true end sub
sub showVideoMetadata() m.videoTitle.text = m.activeContentTitle m.videoDescription.text = m.activeContentDescription m.videoThumbnail.uri = m.activeContentThumbnail m.videoThumbnail.visible = (m.activeContentThumbnail <> "") m.videoLength.text = metadataLengthText(m.activeContentLength) updateVideoProgress() m.videoMetadataShowAnimation.control = "stop" m.videoMetadataPanel.translation = [60, 380] m.videoMetadataPanel.visible = true m.videoMetadataShowAnimation.control = "start" m.topVignette.visible = true m.bottomVignette.visible = true m.videoMetadataVisible = true m.metadataHideTimer.control = "stop" m.metadataHideTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onVideoPositionChanged() if m.active and m.activePlayer = "video" maybePrefetchNext(m.video.position, m.video.duration) if m.videoMetadataPanel.visible then updateVideoProgress() end if end sub
sub updateVideoProgress() position = m.video.position duration = m.video.duration if position = invalid or position < 0 then position = 0 if duration = invalid or duration <= 0 duration = m.activeContentLength if duration < 0 then duration = 0 end if
progressWidth = 0 if duration > 0 progressWidth = int(1130 * position / duration) if progressWidth < 0 then progressWidth = 0 if progressWidth > 1130 then progressWidth = 1130 end if m.videoProgress.width = progressWidth m.videoTime.text = formatTime(position) + " / " + formatTime(duration) end sub
sub updateVideoProgressAt(position as dynamic, duration as dynamic) if position = invalid or position < 0 then position = 0 if duration = invalid or duration <= 0 duration = m.activeContentLength if duration < 0 then duration = 0 end if
progressWidth = 0 if duration > 0 progressWidth = int(1130 * position / duration) if progressWidth < 0 then progressWidth = 0 if progressWidth > 1130 then progressWidth = 1130 end if m.videoProgress.width = progressWidth m.videoTime.text = formatTime(position) + " / " + formatTime(duration) end sub
sub hideVideoMetadata() m.metadataHideTimer.control = "stop" m.videoMetadataShowAnimation.control = "stop" m.videoMetadataPanel.visible = false m.videoMetadataPanel.translation = [60, 380] m.videoThumbnail.uri = "" m.videoProgress.width = 0 m.videoTime.text = "0:00 / 0:00" m.topVignette.visible = false m.bottomVignette.visible = false m.videoMetadataVisible = false end sub
sub onMetadataHideTimer() if m.active and m.activePlayer = "video" and m.videoMetadataVisible hideVideoMetadata() end if end sub
function metadataLengthText(length as integer) as string if length < 0 then return "" return "Length: " + formatTime(length) end function
sub hideAudioPanel() m.audioPanel.visible = false m.audioBackdrop.visible = false m.audioBackdrop.uri = "" m.audioProgress.width = 0 m.audioTime.text = "0:00 / 0:00" end sub
function manifestInteger(key as string, fallback as integer) as integer appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid or text = "" then return fallback value = int(val(text)) if value <= 0 then return fallback return value end function
function manifestOpacity(key as string, fallback as float) as float appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid or text = "" then return fallback value = text.toFloat() if value < 0 then return 0 if value > 1 then return 1 return value end function
sub refreshAudioStatus() if not m.active or m.activePlayer <> "audio" then return m.audioStatusTask.control = "stop" m.audioStatusTask.control = "run" end sub
sub onAudioStatusLoaded(event as object) statusText = event.getData() if statusText <> "" then m.audioVolume.text = statusText end sub
sub onExitDialogButton(event as object) choice = event.getData() m.exitDialog.close = true if choice = 1 then endPlayback("user") end sub
sub onExitDialogClosed() m.exitDialogActive = false if m.active if m.activePlayer = "video" m.video.setFocus(true) else m.top.setFocus(true) end if end if end sub
sub showStatus(message as string) m.statusLabel.text = message m.statusPanel.visible = true m.statusLabel.visible = true end sub
sub hideStatus() m.statusPanel.visible = false m.statusLabel.visible = false end sub
sub endPlayback(reason as string) if m.pendingEndReason <> "" then return m.active = false m.pendingEndReason = reason m.resolvePending = false m.nextResolvePending = false m.prefetchedItem = invalid m.prefetchFailed = false m.transitionWaitingForPrefetch = false m.currentResolveAdvancesLive = false m.liveFallbackAttempts = 0 m.liveFallbackFailed = false m.itemStarted = false m.failurePending = false m.activePlayer = "" m.videoMetadataVisible = false m.lastSeekDirection = "" m.currentItemResolver.control = "stop" m.nextItemResolver.control = "stop" m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" m.prefetchWaitWatchdog.control = "stop" m.skipTimer.control = "stop" m.metadataHideTimer.control = "stop" m.volumeRefreshTimer.control = "stop" m.audioStatusTask.control = "stop" m.videoA.visible = false m.videoB.visible = false m.videoA.control = "stop" m.videoB.control = "stop" m.videoA.content = invalid m.videoB.content = invalid m.audio.control = "stop" hideAudioPanel() hideVideoMetadata() hideStatus() if m.exitDialogActive m.exitDialogActive = false m.exitDialog.close = true end if if m.prefetchWarningActive m.prefetchWarningActive = false if m.prefetchWarningDialog <> invalid then m.prefetchWarningDialog.close = true m.prefetchWarningDialog = invalid end if m.teardownTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub finishPlaybackEnd() if m.pendingEndReason = "" then return reason = m.pendingEndReason m.pendingEndReason = "" m.top.exitReason = reason m.top.playbackEnded = true end sub
